sentences.text: Revenue compounded at 14.7% a year, from $96.6 billion in FY2017 to $332 billion in FY2026 [F1][F10][F221].
Operating margin widened from 30.1% in FY2017 to 46.8% in FY2026, so operating income grew at 20.5% a year, faster than revenue [F41][F50][F223][F221].
Net income fell 35.0% in FY2018 as the effective tax rate reached 54.6%, which the filing ties to the net charge from enacting the TCJA [D48][D32][P61].
FY2026 revenue growth of 17.8% was the fastest in the window after FY2022, driven by growth in Microsoft Cloud [D472][D258][P17].
Microsoft Cloud contributed 16.2pp of FY2026's 17.8% revenue growth and now makes up 64.6% of revenue [D568][D472][D566].
Server products and cloud services added 11.0pp to growth because Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 41% on demand across the platform [D642][P12].
XBOX revenue fell 7.1%, which the filing attributes to declines in both content and services and hardware [D712][P10].
Operating cost growth trailed revenue growth by 10.3pp, and the incremental operating margin was 53.3% against a 46.8% operating margin [D499][D498][F50].
Diluted EPS grew 31.6% against 31.3% for net income, because the diluted share count fell only 0.2% [D476][D474][D493].
The FY2026 operating margin of 46.8% is the window high, above the 41.7% median and the 30.1% low [F50][D974][D975][D973].
The FY2026 bridge was +1.2pp in total: cost of revenue cost 0.9pp, R&D added 0.8pp and other lines added 1.2pp [D487][D500][D501][D502].
Gross margin slipped to 67.9%, as Intelligent Cloud margin percentage fell on AI infrastructure investment and the mix shift to Azure [F30][D486][P11].
Net margin rose 4.2pp against 1.2pp for operating margin, as other income reached $10.7 billion, including $6.5 billion of OpenAI net gains, mainly a dilution gain [D488][D487][X124][P7].
The largest operating margin gain was 4.6pp in FY2021, when the change in estimated useful lives of server and network equipment lifted Intelligent Cloud gross margin [D220][P51].
Operating cash flow of $183 billion was 1.37x net income, but free cash flow of $67.0 billion was only 0.50x, the window low against a 0.91x median [F100][D459][F120][D460][D988][D990].
Capex of $116 billion took 34.9% of revenue and ran at 3.38x depreciation and amortization [F110][D455][D461].
Free cash flow margin fell to 20.2%, the window low, as additions to property and equipment rose $51.4 billion [D456][D982][P1].
Net cash was $72.9 billion in FY2026, up from $66.8 billion in FY2025, or 22.0% of revenue [D465][D411][D466].
That net cash share of revenue ranks in the 83rd percentile among six software peers, whose median is -7.2% [D1006][D1007].
The current ratio of 1.23x is the window low, against a 1.93x median [F200][D991][D993].
Buybacks and dividends totalled $48.7 billion, or 72.7% of free cash flow, while the diluted share count fell 0.2% [D467][D468][D493].
Free cash flow ran at 0.70x net income in FY2025 and 0.50x in FY2026, against a software peer median of 1.90x and a 20th percentile rank [R1][D406][D460][D1009][D1008].
Conversion now depends on capex of 34.9% of revenue earning returns, since operating cash flow growth of 34.4% did not cover it [D455][D477].
FY2026 net income growth of 31.3% includes other income of $10.7 billion, of which OpenAI gains were $6.5 billion against a $4.8 billion loss in FY2025 [D474][X124][P7].
FY2017 pretax income, tax and receivables were later recast, and FY2026 product members overlap, so no conclusion rests on FY2017 tax comparisons or summed product lines [R2][R3][R4][R5].
Free cash flow to net income rising back above the FY2025 level of 0.70x from 0.50x would reverse the conversion decline; the FY2027 10-K will show it [D406][D460].
Intelligent Cloud segment operating margin falling below the FY2026 level of 41.3%, after 42.0% in FY2025, would confirm AI infrastructure costs pressuring margin; see the FY2027 10-K [D963][D962].
Server products and cloud services growth dropping below the FY2025 rate of 23.3% from 31.5% would reverse the acceleration behind the capex build; see the FY2027 10-K [D638][D641].
